inspiration.observed_pattern: A TPC-C benchmark query groups and filters positive quantities independently on two relations, then combines the qualifying key pairs with INTERSECT ALL.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a warehouse/item availability check over order-line and stock-entry facts, preserving grouped SUM/HAVING predicates on both branches and INTERSECT ALL over the resulting key pairs. The source tables, identifiers, values, TPC-C domain, and SQL text are not copied.

fixture_notes: Warehouse/item (1,10) and (2,30) have positive totals in both relations. (1,20) appears only in stock, (2,50) has a non-positive stock total, and (3,40) has a non-positive order total, so all are excluded from the intersection.
determinism_notes: Fixed integer IDs and quantities, grouped key pairs, explicit HAVING predicates, no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE order_lines (line_id INT PRIMARY KEY, warehouse_id INT NOT NULL, item_id INT NOT NULL, quantity INT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE stock_entries (entry_id INT PRIMARY KEY, warehouse_id INT NOT NULL, item_id INT NOT NULL, quantity INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT warehouse_id, item_id FROM order_lines GROUP BY warehouse_id, item_id HAVING SUM(quantity) > 0 INTERSECT ALL SELECT warehouse_id, item_id FROM stock_entries GROUP BY warehouse_id, item_id HAVING SUM(quantity) > 0

checks.sql: SELECT line_id, warehouse_id, item_id, quantity FROM order_lines ORDER BY line_id
SELECT entry_id, warehouse_id, item_id, quantity FROM stock_entries ORDER BY entry_id
